proposed.text: Under RA 8293, when does copyright protection attach to an architectural work covered by Section 172?

options.text: Only after copyright registration is completed with the relevant government office
Only after the building is completed and occupied
By the sole fact of creation, regardless of the mode or form of expression
Only after the design is published in a professional journal

rationale.a: Registration is not the condition stated in Section 172.2.
rationale.b: A work may be protected before a building is completed or occupied.
rationale.d: Publication in a professional journal is not the trigger under Section 172.2.
rationale.correct: RA 8293 Section 172.2 states that works are protected by the sole fact of their creation, irrespective of mode or form of expression, content, quality, or purpose. Registration, completion, occupation, and publication are not stated as prerequisites for copyright protection to attach.
rationale.takeaway: The source phrase to remember is protection by the sole fact of creation.
